    Pascal Rogé - Complete Decca Recordings [Box Set 43CDs] (2026) MP3



    Classical
    MP3 320 Kbps | 7.46 Gb

    Pascal Rogé was an exclusive Decca artist in the 1970s and '80s, extensively documenting the music of Ravel, Debussy, Satie, and Poulenc. Concertos, chamber music, solo piano music and song, Mozart, Beethoven, Saint-Saëns, and Fauré all feature in this comprehensive 43-CD box with original jackets. Includes two previously unpublished works - Brahms' 'Second Sonata', left unpublished for want of a suitable coupling, and a selection of preludes by the Japanese composer Takashi Yoshimatsu (b. 1953). Also published for the first time on Decca is a recording of Mozart concertos with Raymond Leppard. The set is accompanied by a fascinating essay by piano specialist Jeremy Nicholas, incorporating reminiscences by Rogé about the background to these recordings, and his serendipitous introduction to Decca.

    Contains CDs:

    CD 1-2:
    BARTÓK: Piano Concertos Nos. 1–3; Rhapsody.
    London Symphony Orchestra / Walter Weller

    FRANCK: Variations symphoniques
    Cleveland Orchestra / Lorin Maazel

    CD 3:
    BEETHOVEN: Piano Quintet; SPOHR: Septet
    London Winds, Chantal Juillet, Christopher van Kampen

    CD 4–5:
    BRAHMS: Four Ballades Op. 10; Handel Variations Op.24 (1977 & 1991 recordings); Two Rhapsodies Op. 79; Fantasias Op. 116; Piano Sonata No. 2* (*previously unpublished)

    CD 6:
    BRAHMS: Violin Sonatas Nos. 1–3; Scherzo from ‘F-A-E’ Sonata
    Pierre Amoyal

    CD 7:
    CHAUSSON: Concert; FRANCK: Violin Sonata
    Pierre Amoyal; Ysaÿe Quartet

    CD 8–12:
    DEBUSSY: Piano music
    Danse bohémienne; Deux Arabesques; Estampes; Mazurka; Pour le Piano; Rêverie; Suite bergamasque; Images I & II; L’isle joyeuse; D’un cahier d’esquisses; Masques; Danse; Children’s Corner; Préludes Book I (Decca recordings)
    Préludes Book II; La plus que lente; Ballade; Le petit negre; Berceuse héroïque; Hommage à Haydn; Pièce pour l’œuvre du ‘Vêtement du blessé’; Douze Études (Onyx recordings)

    CD 13:
    FAURÉ: Piano works

    CD 14
    FAURÉ: Violin Sonatas Nos. 1 & 2; Berceuse Op.16; Romance Op.28; Andante in B flat Op.75; Morceau de lecture
    Pierre Amoyal

    CD 15–16:
    FAURÉ: Piano Quartets Nos. 1 & 2; Piano Quintets Nos. 1 & 2
    Quatour Ysaÿe

    CD 17:
    FRANCK: Variations symphoniques; Cello Sonata (after Violin Sonata); Piano Quintet (ASV recording)
    Ross Pople (cello / conductor), London Festival Orchestra

    CD 18:
    Liszt: Piano Sonata; Mazeppa; Vallée d’Obermann; Liebestraum S541/3.

    BONUS: Giordano: Fedora / Act 2: Se innocente sei davvero, crederà
    Magda Olivero, Mario del Monaco, Monte Carlo Opera Orchestra / Lamberto Gardelli

    CD 19:
    LISZT: Années de pèlerinage: Italie S161

    CD 20:
    MOZART: Piano Concertos Nos. 9 & 25; Rondo K.386 (first release on Decca)
    Six Minuets K.1-5, K9a
    Indianapolis Symphony Orchestra / Raymond Leppard

    CD 21:
    POULENC: Piano Concerto; Concerto for 2 Pianos; Concert champêtre
    Sylviane Deferne (Concerto for 2 Pianos); Philharmonia Orchestra (piano concertos) / Charles Dutoit; French National Orchestra (Concert champêtre) / Charles Dutoit

    CD 22:
    POULENC: Aubade; Suite française; Le Bal masqué; Rapsodie nègre
    François le Roux; French National Orchestra (Concert champêtre) / Charles Dutoit

    CD 23–25
    POULENC: Piano works

    CD 26:
    POULENC: Music for 2 pianos/4 hands; Violin Sonata
    Jean-Philippe Collard; Chantal Juillet

    CD 27:
    POULENC: Sextet, Trio, Oboe Sonata, Clarinet Sonata, Flute Sonata
    Patrick Gallois, Maurice Bourgue, Michel Portal, Amaury Wallez, Andre Cazalet

    CD 28–31:
    POULENC: Mélodies
    Catherine Dubosc, Gilles Cachemaille, Felicity Lott, Ursula Kryger, François Le Roux

    CD 32:
    RAVEL: Piano Concertos; SAINT-SAËNS: Carnival of the Animals
    Cristina Ortiz; Montreal Symphony Orchestra / Charles Dutoit

    CD 33–35:
    RAVEL: Piano music
    Le Tombeau de Couperin, Valses nobles et sentimentales, Sonatine; A la manière de Borodine; A la manière de Chabrier; Gaspard de la nuit; Menuet antique; Menuet sur le nom de Haydn; Pavane pour une infante défunte; Prélude; Jeux d’eau; Miroirs; Ma mère l’oye (with Denise Françoise Rogé)

    CD 36:
    RAVEL: Violin Sonata (1897); Violin Sonata; Tzigane; Berceuse; Kaddisch; Pièce en forme de habanera
    Chantal Juillet

    CD 37–38:
    SAINT-SAËNS: Piano Concertos Nos. 1–5
    London Philharmonic Orchestra, Philharmonia Orchestra, Royal Philharmonic Orchestra / Charles Dutoit

    CD 39–42:
    SATIE: Piano Music (including works for four-hands*)
    YOSHIMATSU: 7 Pleiades Dances (previously unpublished)
    *Jean-Philippe Collard

    CD 43:
    French Chamber Music – Saint-Saëns, d’Indy, Tansman, Francaix, Roussel, Poulenc, Milhaud
    Catherine Cantin, Maurice Bourgue, Michel Portal, Amaury Wallez, Andre Cazalet

    Pascal Rogé (piano)

    Steven Wilson - The Harmony Codex (Super Deluxe Edition) (2023) Blu-ray Audio



    The blu-ray in the deluxe package offers the expected Dolby Atmos, 5.1 and hi-res stereo but adds instrumentals (in the same three audio streams) which are not included in the standalone blu-ray (both blu-rays also include two videos). The Carl Glover-designed hardback book features Hajo Mueller’s stunning artwork, meticulously created over an 18 month period in close collaboration with Steven during the making of the album.

    Quality: Blu-ray | Container: BDMV | Video codec: MPEG4 Video | Audio Codec: DTS-HD Master Audio; Dolby TrueHD/Atmos Audio, PCM, AC3
    Genre: Rock, Prog Rock, Electronic | Duration: 01:04:05 | Size: 14.45 GB

    Video: MPEG4 Video (H264) 1920x1080 24fps [V: h264 high L4.1, yuv420p, 1920x1080]
    Audio: TrueHD 48000Hz 8ch 9216kbps [A: English [eng] (truehd atmos, 48000 Hz, 7.1, s24)]
    Audio: Dolby AC3 48000Hz 6ch 640kbps [A: English [eng] (ac3, 48000 Hz, 5.1(side), 640 kb/s) [sub]]
    Audio: DTS 96000Hz 6ch 13824kbps [A: English [eng] (dts-hd ma, 96000 Hz, 5.1(side), s24)]
    Audio: 0x4448 96000Hz stereo 4608kbps [A: English [eng] (pcm_bluray, 96000 Hz, stereo, s24, 4608 kb/s)]

    Tracklist:

    1. Inclination (07:16)
    2. What Life Brings (03:39)

    7. The Harmony Codex (09:50)

    Pascal Rogé - Complete Decca Recordings [Box Set 43CDs] (2026) FLAC



    Classical
    FLAC (Tracks) | 12.2 Gb

    Pascal Rogé was an exclusive Decca artist in the 1970s and '80s, extensively documenting the music of Ravel, Debussy, Satie, and Poulenc. Concertos, chamber music, solo piano music and song, Mozart, Beethoven, Saint-Saëns, and Fauré all feature in this comprehensive 43-CD box with original jackets. Includes two previously unpublished works - Brahms' 'Second Sonata', left unpublished for want of a suitable coupling, and a selection of preludes by the Japanese composer Takashi Yoshimatsu (b. 1953). Also published for the first time on Decca is a recording of Mozart concertos with Raymond Leppard. The set is accompanied by a fascinating essay by piano specialist Jeremy Nicholas, incorporating reminiscences by Rogé about the background to these recordings, and his serendipitous introduction to Decca.

    Contains CDs:

    CD 1-2:
    BARTÓK: Piano Concertos Nos. 1–3; Rhapsody.
    London Symphony Orchestra / Walter Weller

    FRANCK: Variations symphoniques
    Cleveland Orchestra / Lorin Maazel

    CD 3:
    BEETHOVEN: Piano Quintet; SPOHR: Septet
    London Winds, Chantal Juillet, Christopher van Kampen

    CD 4–5:
    BRAHMS: Four Ballades Op. 10; Handel Variations Op.24 (1977 & 1991 recordings); Two Rhapsodies Op. 79; Fantasias Op. 116; Piano Sonata No. 2* (*previously unpublished)

    CD 6:
    BRAHMS: Violin Sonatas Nos. 1–3; Scherzo from ‘F-A-E’ Sonata
    Pierre Amoyal

    CD 7:
    CHAUSSON: Concert; FRANCK: Violin Sonata
    Pierre Amoyal; Ysaÿe Quartet

    CD 8–12:
    DEBUSSY: Piano music
    Danse bohémienne; Deux Arabesques; Estampes; Mazurka; Pour le Piano; Rêverie; Suite bergamasque; Images I & II; L’isle joyeuse; D’un cahier d’esquisses; Masques; Danse; Children’s Corner; Préludes Book I (Decca recordings)
    Préludes Book II; La plus que lente; Ballade; Le petit negre; Berceuse héroïque; Hommage à Haydn; Pièce pour l’œuvre du ‘Vêtement du blessé’; Douze Études (Onyx recordings)

    CD 13:
    FAURÉ: Piano works

    CD 14
    FAURÉ: Violin Sonatas Nos. 1 & 2; Berceuse Op.16; Romance Op.28; Andante in B flat Op.75; Morceau de lecture
    Pierre Amoyal

    CD 15–16:
    FAURÉ: Piano Quartets Nos. 1 & 2; Piano Quintets Nos. 1 & 2
    Quatour Ysaÿe

    CD 17:
    FRANCK: Variations symphoniques; Cello Sonata (after Violin Sonata); Piano Quintet (ASV recording)
    Ross Pople (cello / conductor), London Festival Orchestra

    CD 18:
    Liszt: Piano Sonata; Mazeppa; Vallée d’Obermann; Liebestraum S541/3.

    BONUS: Giordano: Fedora / Act 2: Se innocente sei davvero, crederà
    Magda Olivero, Mario del Monaco, Monte Carlo Opera Orchestra / Lamberto Gardelli

    CD 19:
    LISZT: Années de pèlerinage: Italie S161

    CD 20:
    MOZART: Piano Concertos Nos. 9 & 25; Rondo K.386 (first release on Decca)
    Six Minuets K.1-5, K9a
    Indianapolis Symphony Orchestra / Raymond Leppard

    CD 21:
    POULENC: Piano Concerto; Concerto for 2 Pianos; Concert champêtre
    Sylviane Deferne (Concerto for 2 Pianos); Philharmonia Orchestra (piano concertos) / Charles Dutoit; French National Orchestra (Concert champêtre) / Charles Dutoit

    CD 22:
    POULENC: Aubade; Suite française; Le Bal masqué; Rapsodie nègre
    François le Roux; French National Orchestra (Concert champêtre) / Charles Dutoit

    CD 23–25
    POULENC: Piano works

    CD 26:
    POULENC: Music for 2 pianos/4 hands; Violin Sonata
    Jean-Philippe Collard; Chantal Juillet

    CD 27:
    POULENC: Sextet, Trio, Oboe Sonata, Clarinet Sonata, Flute Sonata
    Patrick Gallois, Maurice Bourgue, Michel Portal, Amaury Wallez, Andre Cazalet

    CD 28–31:
    POULENC: Mélodies
    Catherine Dubosc, Gilles Cachemaille, Felicity Lott, Ursula Kryger, François Le Roux

    CD 32:
    RAVEL: Piano Concertos; SAINT-SAËNS: Carnival of the Animals
    Cristina Ortiz; Montreal Symphony Orchestra / Charles Dutoit

    CD 33–35:
    RAVEL: Piano music
    Le Tombeau de Couperin, Valses nobles et sentimentales, Sonatine; A la manière de Borodine; A la manière de Chabrier; Gaspard de la nuit; Menuet antique; Menuet sur le nom de Haydn; Pavane pour une infante défunte; Prélude; Jeux d’eau; Miroirs; Ma mère l’oye (with Denise Françoise Rogé)

    CD 36:
    RAVEL: Violin Sonata (1897); Violin Sonata; Tzigane; Berceuse; Kaddisch; Pièce en forme de habanera
    Chantal Juillet

    CD 37–38:
    SAINT-SAËNS: Piano Concertos Nos. 1–5
    London Philharmonic Orchestra, Philharmonia Orchestra, Royal Philharmonic Orchestra / Charles Dutoit

    CD 39–42:
    SATIE: Piano Music (including works for four-hands*)
    YOSHIMATSU: 7 Pleiades Dances (previously unpublished)
